profile: Technologist with 14+ years building AI systems from research prototype to production at scale. Combines deep ML foundations with hands-on product engineering — designing multi-agent orchestration systems, shipping full-stack AI-native platforms, and leading enterprise AI transformation. Proven across the full spectrum: enterprise R&D with nine-figure cost implications at Costco, and zero-to-one product builds as a technical co-founder. Particularly experienced in agentic AI architecture — named-agent pipelines with LLM tool use, streaming, session memory, governance and multi-provider model routing — alongside computer vision, real-time systems, and full-stack development. Adept at partnering with executives to align AI roadmaps with business priorities, and at building high-performing multidisciplinary teams. Particularly equipped and passionate about greenfield projects.

experience.summary: Enterprise AI platforms, retail agent orchestration, and applied research across computer vision and security.
highlights: Led the design and deployment of a Retail Agentic Platform with Supervisor/ReAct orchestration, intent-based routing, specialized worker agents, a tool registry, Redis-backed session memory, and I/O guardrails on GKE.

Delivered a full-stack Enterprise AI Platform on Kubernetes: React chat UI and BFF, vector knowledge API, document ingestion, LLM orchestration, and analytics. Consolidated nine microservice stubs into a single in-process orchestration layer.
Architected a hybrid Azure and on-premises AI/ML platform that reduced data processing times by 90%.
Proposed and prototyped computer vision models for automated checkout, smart carts, and shrink/loss prevention.
Built and led a multidisciplinary AI team delivering a 50% improvement in threat detection and multi-million-dollar cost avoidance.
Shaped the enterprise AI R&D roadmap and aligned initiatives with C-suite business priorities.

experience.summary: Technical co-founding across an AI-native construction and real estate platform, from agent orchestration to product delivery.
highlights: Designed and built a multi-agent AI orchestrator coordinating FORGE, SCOUT, SENTINEL, LEDGER, and PROCURE across estimating, contractor matching, risk, payments, and materials, with LLM tool use, streaming, and persistent session memory.
Built FARO, a context-aware AI assistant with page-context routing, prompt caching, rate limiting, and real-time streaming.
Developed an AI Deal Analyzer for investment underwriting: market scanning, comparable analysis, scenario modeling, and underwriting recovery flows.

Architected the platform with React 19, TypeScript, tRPC, Express 5, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, Stream Chat, Resend, Twilio, and Expo/React Native. Implemented model routing across OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Ollama.
Delivered marketplace, bidding, project execution, milestone billing, escrow, compliance, and real-time messaging workflows.
Established migration safety matrices, CI/CD governance gates, release readiness scoring, and progressive rollout practices.

experience.summary: A medical transportation platform connecting dispatcher tools, driver applications, and secure operations.
highlights: Architected a HIPAA-adjacent, multi-tenant medical transportation platform with PHI field-level encryption, tenant isolation, audit logging, and compliance gate controls.
Built a full-stack monorepo with a Spring Boot REST API in Java 17, React and Vite dispatcher/admin applications, a React Native and Expo driver app, and shared TypeScript libraries.
Implemented partner onboarding, legal gate controls, and pilot role-readiness automation with full E2E test coverage.
